svg.title: AutoLearnPro academic pathway structure diagram
svg.desc: Flowchart. The academic pathway structure splits into two academic levels. Undergraduate: 48 pathway courses under CIP 47.0604 — AUT 100-199 Foundations (13), AUT 200-299 Core Systems (12) and AUT 300-499 Advanced Technology (18), plus 5 named subject courses (Brakes, Electrical, Engine Performance, Hybrid and Electric Vehicle Technology, Suspension and Steering). Graduate: 30 pathway courses under CIP 15.0803 — AUT 500-599 Graduate Core and Specializations (18) and AUT 600-699 Research and Professional Practice (7), plus 5 named graduate courses (Advanced Diagnostic Analysis, Applied Research, Curriculum and Assessment Design, Technical Instructional Leadership, Vehicle Systems and Testing). The AUT-numbered courses lead to a unique course catalog record, and every catalog record has a stable course detail URL; the catalog holds 68 records in total (43 undergraduate, 25 graduate). Each record branches on whether curriculum content is developed: yes leads to a competency and lesson plan and then to evidence-governed learning; not yet leads to a catalog-only planned course.
